_note: The ending's cutscenes are ending.victory and ending.defeat (src/data/cutscenes.json; M8) and their lines are in src/data/dialogue.json (ending.*). What's left here is the point-of-no-return pop-up.

noReturn._note: Aaron (Session 9, #130): both charges on the hut. A radio call (dialogue.json noReturn.radio), then this pop-up: once they go off there's no reloading from dawn.
noReturn.title: POINT OF NO RETURN
noReturn.text: Both charges are on the hut. Once you set them off, the final battle begins and your save is deleted: you can't reload from dawn. Get clear, then set them off with the detonator (RT) when you're ready.
